rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the quality of being broad-minded, generous, and willing to forgive.

example.english: They don't get angry even when misunderstood; they have real magnanimity.
example.traditional: 佢俾人誤會咗都唔嬲，真係好有氣量。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 ng6 wui6 zo2 dou1 m4 nau1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 hei3 loeng6
